"Make a playstation 5 experience where it says press the playstation icon. And it turns on and you press on the profile and it smoothly goes into a game library of fan favourite playable playstation OG games like fortnite, rocket league, roblox, Fifa 23 and when you click playstation plus it will say congratulations you are now a premium member of playstation plus. When you press confirm and it 
Will show you a massive catalogue of games in the playstation plus collection and monthly games and the playstation store and realistic update system software downloads and game downloads and updates.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
